text: 公募基金年内分红超1200亿元，债券型基金贡献逾六成，多只宽基ETF分红金额居前。与此同时，权益基金分红次数同比增加近八成，31家公募机构旗下产品分红金额超过10亿元。业内人士表示，在市场波动背景下，基金分红可以兑现部分收益，既有助于提升产品吸引力，也能在一定程度上帮助投资者锁定收益、缓解持仓压力。（上海证券报）
text_en: Public funds distributed more than RMB 120 billion in dividends during the year, with bond funds contributing more than 60%, and several broad-based ETFs ranking high in dividend amounts. At the same time, the number of dividend distributions by equity funds increased by nearly 80% year-on-year, and products under 31 public fund institutions paid dividends exceeding RMB 1 billion. Industry insiders said that amid market volatility, fund dividends can realize part of the returns, which helps enhance product appeal and can also, to a certain extent, help investors lock in returns and ease pressure on holdings. (Shanghai Securities News)
